title: GridLiance West’s Transmission Upgrades Project Breaks Ground to Strengthen Nevada's Electric Grid and Support Economic Growth
summary: GridLiance West has broken ground on a major transmission upgrade project in Nevada that will modernize the grid, create approximately 500 construction jobs and support the state's growing energy needs.
body_markdown:
**JEAN, Nev., --** GridLiance West, a subsidiary of NextEra Energy Transmission, LLC, today joined federal, state and local leaders to celebrate the start of construction on the GridLiance West Core Upgrades Project, approximately 155 miles of new 230-kilovolt and 500-kilovolt transmission lines and new and upgraded substations in Nevada that will enhance the reliability of the electric grid and support the state's continued economic growth.


**Why it matters**


The GridLiance West Core Upgrades Project represents a long-term investment in Nevada's energy future. Designed to replace existing infrastructure and expand transmission capacity, the transmission upgrades will help ensure homes, businesses and industries have access to reliable and affordable electricity for decades to come.


When completed in mid-2028, the expanded transmission network will unlock access to additional energy resources, create opportunities for new industrial investment and generate tax revenue for local communities that will help support schools, emergency services and public infrastructure.


**By the numbers**


The GridLiance West Core Upgrades project represents:


- 500 jobs created during construction


- Estimated $90 million in property and sales tax revenue


- Estimated $553 million in annual economic impact


**A word from Matt Valle, president of NextEra Energy Transmission**


"This is a significant investment in Nevada's energy future and demonstrates the critical role transmission infrastructure plays in powering homes, businesses and industries. Economic growth depends on reliable, affordable electricity and the infrastructure needed to deliver it. Today's groundbreaking reflects what can be achieved through strong collaboration among industry, government and local communities."


**A word from Nevada Governor Joe Lombardo**


“This project is another important step toward securing Nevada’s energy future and strengthening our position as the energy hub of the West. Reliable, affordable energy is essential to supporting Nevada’s growing economy, creating good-paying jobs and attracting new investment. By modernizing and expanding our transmission infrastructure, we are building the capacity needed to power Nevada’s continued growth and ensure our state is ready to meet the energy demands of the future.”


**A word from Katie Jereza, Assistant Secretary, U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Electricity**


“This infrastructure improvement project demonstrates the impact of collaboration among industry, federal and state government, tribes and communities to further America’s energy dominance. The upgrades to transmission lines and substations will boost local economies with construction jobs, annual economic impact and tax revenue that benefit schools, emergency services and public infrastructure. Being able to add another 1 gigawatt of capacity to Nevada’s electric grid will provide access to affordable and reliable electricity across the state.”


**A word from Robby Hamlin, Chief Executive Officer, Valley Electric Association**


*“* As a member-owned cooperative, every major decision we make is guided by the value it delivers to our members. Our collaboration with GridLiance West represents an important investment in the future of our cooperative and the communities we serve. By connecting to a larger transmission network through GridLiance West’s Core Upgrades Project, Valley Electric gains access to significant transmission investment, expertise and resources needed to strengthen system reliability, enhance resilience and support the continued growth of our region. Our members will benefit from critical infrastructure improvements that help modernize our system, meet evolving energy needs and support long-term affordability. Just as importantly, Valley Electric will remain locally governed and focused on the people we serve. We believe this collaboration creates the right balance of local stewardship and regional strength, delivering lasting value to our members and the communities we serve for years to come.”


**About NextEra Energy Transmission**


NextEra Energy Transmission, LLC, is one of North America’s leading competitive transmission companies. NextEra Energy Transmission has more than 3,200 miles of transmission lines in development and operation in 19 states and Canada and a strong track record of delivering complex projects that benefit customers and communities. NextEra Energy Transmission is a subsidiary of NextEra Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NEE), the largest electric power and energy infrastructure company in North America and a leading provider of electricity to American homes and businesses. For more information about NextEra Energy Transmission, please visit https://www.nexteraenergytransmission.com/.
